page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a thread-per-core ratio of 1.0, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from simultaneous multithreading.

The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by an 80 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating high-throughput data transfers, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

This hardware profile represents a compute-optimized configuration where CPU resources are prioritized over memory capacity. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it cost-efficient for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive in-memory databases but benefit from dedicated physical execution units. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of local NVMe storage and integrated GPU accelerators. This instance is designed for workloads such as high-performance computing, batch processing, compute-intensive web serving, and distributed analytics.
